bifrost: springboard/src/shell/photos/ (viewer, edit, slideshow, thumbs), springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_imageio.rs, springboard/ui/src/print.rs, springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/, springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs, springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs
summary: BifrOSt covers the viewing and editing side of ImageKit only inside shell apps (Photos viewer, edit mode and slideshow), a Quick Look preview model and thumbnail cache in the SDK, PDF reading and writing through the SDK document and writer wrappers, PNG and JPEG decode and encode, and PDF text extraction for Books. No app-facing SDK API exists yet for image views, slideshows, Core Image filters, PDF outlines or selections, or Quartz Composer.

features.note: Full-screen viewer with paging, pinch and double-tap zoom and pan, and a grid of thumbnails, all inside the Photos shell app. The zoom arithmetic, grid layout and viewer gestures are tested in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-08.rs. Gap: no SDK view for apps to embed an image view or browser.

features.feature: Image editing panel and save options (IKImageEditPanel, IKSaveOptions)
features.note: Edit mode does quarter-turn rotate, straighten, crop to aspect presets, brightness and contrast, and saves a copy (save_copy). The save options are a tested model (format, JPEG quality clamped to 0 to 1, name suffix, numbered names when a file is taken) in save_options. Gap: the save sheet is not wired to that model, and there is no edit panel for apps; the panel needs the shell and the lab machine.

Slide timing, cross-fade layers, pausing, stepping, the control timeout and the drift geometry are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01.rs. Gap: the slideshow lives in Photos only, with no SDK type and no screen saver hook.

features.feature: Core Image filters and filter browser (CIFilter, IKFilterBrowserView, IKFilterUIView)
features.note: Wave 5 (w5-quartz, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Five fixed per-pixel colour filters (Original, Vivid, Mono, Noir, Warm). No filter graph, no parameterised CIFilter-style objects, no filter browser and no kernel or GPU image processing API.

features.feature: Camera device browser and picture taker (IKDeviceBrowserView, IKCameraDeviceView, IKPictureTaker)
features.note: Camera app has a live viewfinder, timer, QR scanner and last-photo thumbnail, opened by the shell only. No SDK device browser, picture-taker panel or camera download delegate. The camera stream is only touched while the app is open.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (theme-33, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No scanner support: the only scanner hits in the tree are the camera QR decoder and unrelated text.

features.apple: IKImageView input (CGImage-backed image loading); no direct Quartz decode call in this framework
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_imageio.rs (detect, pixel_size, decode, encode, encode_jpeg); springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (fit, cover, contain)
features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. The app-facing detect, decode, PNG and JPEG encode and their refusals are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-07-w7.rs. No app calls it yet.

features.feature: Quick Look preview panel (QLPreviewPanel, QLPreviewItem, QLPreviewPanelDataSource)
features.note: The SDK has the panel model: items, index clamp, step, toggle, show and close. The shell decodes the Preview message but never draws the panel, so nothing shows on screen. No app is adopted yet. Model tests (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01c.rs): the_panel_steps_without_wrapping_and_the_index_stays_in_range, a_pull_clamps_the_current_index_into_the_new_list, a_display_state_past_the_end_is_refused. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/thumbnails.rs (request, reply, event, State, load_pixels); springboard/ui/src/thumb_service.rs (request and answer models)
features.note: Apps ask the thumbnails service for a picture of a file at a size and scale; the shell keeps a disk cache shared by all apps, answers pending requests with ready or failed events, and gives the type icon for files with no picture. The shell providers draw the pictures; there is no app-side generator and no update handlers. Tests (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01c.rs): a_picture_answer_names_the_cached_image_and_its_size, an_icon_answer_keeps_the_type_and_the_badge_and_pending_has_neither, a_failed_answer_carries_the_reason, only_the_thumbnail_events_of_the_thumbnail_service_are_read.

Wave 4 (theme-22, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests (preview_view_tests in sdk/src/peek.rs, and springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01c.rs: an_embedded_view_loads_a_new_item_until_the_app_reports_ready, without_autostart_an_embedded_item_waits_at_ready, a_refresh_needs_an_item_and_is_counted, closing_a_view_returns_its_item_and_resets_the_state, a_window_close_closes_the_view_only_when_the_switch_is_on); not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No embeddable preview view; the peek.rs gap list says the same.

features.feature: PDF document model (PDFDocument, PDFPage, PDFOutline, PDFSelection)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs (Document), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/doc.rs, springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/obj.rs, springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/extract.rs; tests sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs
features.note: Apps can open a PDF, read the page count and sizes, and render a page through graphics_pdf::Document, tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs. Gap: outline, selection and text extraction are not in the SDK; Books uses extract.rs directly.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/mod.rs (assemble, load, probe; reflow into the shared page model); wired: springboard/apps/books-desktop/src/books/mod.rs (Panel::Pages); tests springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs
features.note: PDF text is reflowed into paragraphs, headings and images in the Books page model; headless tests in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs cover the reflow rules. Gap: no fixed-layout page view, thumbnail view, zoom or selection for apps; PDFCraft is a third-party upstream binary, not an SDK API, and needs a Midget check.

features.feature: PDF annotations and form widgets (PDFAnnotation, PDFAppearanceCharacteristics, PDFBorder, widgets)
features.apple: PDFAnnotation, PDFAction, PDFDestination, PDFAppearanceCharacteristics, PDFBorder; widget how-to articles
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 5 (w5-quartz, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The PDF engine reads no annotations or AcroForm fields. PDFCraft's annotation UI comes from the upstream binary and is not reachable from apps.

features.feature: PDF writing, print workflow and Quartz filters (QuartzFilter, QuartzFilterManager)
features.apple: QuartzFilter, QuartzFilterManager, QuartzFilterView, Quartz Filter Constants
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs (PdfWriter, PdfPage), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/writer.rs, springboard/ui/src/print.rs (PrintOperation, Destination::Pdf), springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (write_pdf); tests sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs
features.note: PdfWriter creates files from pages of rectangles, lines and images, tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs. Gap: no text, no print-to-PDF filter pipeline and no QuartzFilter manager; Save as PDF in the print sheet still copies the file.

features.feature: Quartz Composer compositions and custom patches (QCComposition, QCView, QCPlugIn, QCRenderer)
features.apple: QCComposition, QCCompositionLayer, QCView, QCRenderer, QCPlugIn, QCPlugInContext, QCCompositionRepository
features.note: Blocked: no node-graph composition runtime (patch graph, renderer, plug-in host) exists in this repository, and it is a separate multi-module project rather than a surface over existing code. The deprecation status was not checked against the official documentation.

gaps: No SDK image view or image browser for apps (ImageKit IKImageView and IKImageBrowserView); image viewing exists only inside the Photos shell app.
No parameterised image filter API (Core Image CIFilter) and no filter browser; Photos has five fixed colour filters.
No scanner support (IKScannerDeviceView) and no SDK camera device browser or picture taker.
The Quick Look panel model in springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs is not drawn by the shell (ToShell::Preview is decoded and ignored) and no app adopts it; no QLPreviewView.
No PDF outline, selection or text access for apps (PDFOutline, PDFSelection); graphics_pdf::Document exposes page count, size and rendering only.
No PDF annotation or form widget support in the PDF engine, which reads no annotations or AcroForm fields; PDFCraft's annotation UI is not reachable from apps.
No PDF text in PdfWriter and no print-to-PDF filter pipeline (QuartzFilter); Save as PDF in the print sheet copies the file.
No Quartz Composer equivalent (QCComposition, QCView, custom patches).
